claim: Amazon disclosed $1.68 in diluted EPS and $173.9B in revenue for the second fiscal quarter of 2025.
summary: The claim combines two assertions for Amazon Q2 FY2025 (quarter ended June 30, 2025). Diluted EPS of $1.68 matches Amazon's reported Q2 FY2025 results released July 31, 2025. Reported net sales/revenue was approximately $167.7B, not $173.9B, so the revenue assertion is contradicted and the combined claim is false.

sub_claims.text: Amazon disclosed diluted EPS of $1.68 for the second fiscal quarter of 2025
sub_claims.note: Consistent with model knowledge without tools: Amazon reported diluted EPS of $1.68 for Q2 FY2025 (quarter ended June 30, 2025) on July 31, 2025.

sub_claims.text: Amazon disclosed revenue of $173.9B for the second fiscal quarter of 2025
sub_claims.note: Contradicted by model knowledge without tools: Amazon reported net sales/revenue of approximately $167.7B for Q2 FY2025, not $173.9B. Stated_value is in billions of USD.
